race.title: Albert Bartlett Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Hyde) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: DIVINE DIVA was back to looking much more the bright prospect she'd appeared when placed in a listed bumper at this meeting last year when scoring in good style on her recent hurdling debut at Chepstow and it looks significant Harry Skelton has chosen her over Hitintheheadlines , who accounted for 4 next-time-out winners on his first go over hurdles at the aforementioned venue. Ferocimo cruised clear in the manner of an above-average novice at Fontwell and is a very interesting contender, too. DIVINE DIVA (IRE) HITINTHEHEADLINES (IRE) FEROCIMO (IRE)
